candidates.statement: Checkout 502s stem from inventory's redis reserve_inventory timing out (~2s), surfacing as DependencyUnavailable and propagating 503/502 up through order to gateway checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Redis-side metrics/logs not observed; whether timeout is redis saturation vs network is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts in inventory cascading to order ReadTimeouts and gateway 502s on /v1/checkout; topology confirms inventory->redis path. Bounded to redis-timeout.
